en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large Baroque-style waterside castle with multiple round corner towers topped by domes and lanterns, a central façade with an ornate entrance and balcony, and a tall church-like spire rising behind. The castle stands behind a formal garden and trees on the opposite bank of a calm lake or moat, photographed from across the water under a lightly clouded sky. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.
